note: U.S. regular market open is 8:30 a.m. Central / 9:30 a.m. Eastern. The second check is set to 8:35 a.m. Central to review the first post-open conditions while keeping the schedule to six checks per day.

tasks.label: Pre-market research and readiness
instructions: Read AGENTS.md, strategy, schedule, continuity, readiness, current-state, and latest journal.
Read news, official calendars, account state if available, and overnight market context.
Generate today's watchlist.
Do not place orders.

tasks.label: Post-open opportunity review
instructions: Check first post-open price, spread, liquidity, and volume conditions.
Check whether any high-liquidity stock or ETF meets multi-evidence entry conditions.
Record trade candidates, risks, and no-trade reasons.
Use paper trading only unless a separately confirmed live order has been authorized.

tasks.label: Position and final new-entry review
instructions: Check existing positions.
Decide whether to hold, reduce, stop out, or ignore new opportunities.
This is the last scheduled slot for considering a new paper trade unless risk is already open.

tasks.label: Risk management only
instructions: Manage existing positions.
Do not actively expand risk.
Update risk, cash, open thesis, and next action.

tasks.label: Prepare to close intraday risk
instructions: Prepare to close remaining intraday positions unless overnight hold is explicitly allowed in the strategy.
Reduce tail risk.
Record any unresolved data or order issues.

tasks.label: End-of-day reconciliation
instructions: Confirm exit from positions that should not remain overnight.
Record daily results, evidence, current holdings, cash, risk, and next run instructions.
Flag any human confirmation needed.
